name: Subsense
note: Emerged from stealth Feb 2025 with $17M seed (BusinessWire); a stealth company predates its unveiling, so the launch year is not a founding year. Palo Alto, co-founders Tetiana Aleksandrova and Artem Sokolov.

name: BrainCom
note: The company at braincom.fr in Bagneux appears to be a strategic-communications agency, not a neurotech company. The neurotech BrainCom is an EU research PROJECT at braincom-project.com. Worth a scope review against INCLUSION_RULE.

name: ApexNeuro
note: A neurorehabilitation CLINIC in Manchester (6 employees, Trustpilot-reviewed patient services), not a company whose product interfaces with or modulates the nervous system. No founding year found. Scope review against INCLUSION_RULE.

name: Accure Therapeutics
note: Develops CNS DRUGS (multiple sclerosis, Parkinson) from the Iproteos/Bionure merger. INCLUSION_RULE explicitly excludes companies developing drugs for neurological indications. Founding year written regardless; scope is a separate decision.

name: ableX
note: ableX healthcare Limited, Auckland, develops stroke-recovery products. Search returned the company but no founding year from any source; results were dominated by unrelated NZ rehab providers.

name: Aspen Neuroscience
note: Autologous iPSC-derived dopamine neuron replacement THERAPY for Parkinson (ANPD001) — a cell therapy drug, not a device or software interfacing with the nervous system. INCLUSION_RULE excludes drug developers. Year written; scope is a separate decision.

name: MedEngine
note: Two distinct companies share the name. MedEngine Oy, Helsinki, founded 2014, is pharma medical data science. MedEngine GmbH, Berlin, founded 2017, makes a Parkinson tracking wristwatch. Our record says Helsinki AND Parkinson, which matches neither cleanly. Needs a person to decide which company the row is. VERIFIED: medengine.fi is a pharma consulting agency (market access, medical communications), acquired by Voisin Consulting Life Sciences in 2023 — not neurotech. MedEngine GmbH Berlin, founded 2017, Techstars 20, built the Flytta Parkinson wearable and ceased operations around Aug 2023; that is almost certainly the company this row means.

name: Brainguard
note: A Berkeley News piece of Jan 2020 says BrainGuard was founded by Robert Knight eight years earlier, implying 2012. No source states a year outright. An arithmetic inference from a rounded phrase is not a sourced fact. A verifier additionally found Bicycle Retailer (Jul 2026) stating "Founded in 2011", which conflicts with the Berkeley arithmetic and may itself be aggregator-derived. Still unresolved.

name: Gaia Wearables
note: RIT alumni startup (Brent Chase, Joseph Clifford, Liam Herlihy), wearable for children with autism; founders graduated 2017 and coverage is 2018, but no source states a founding year. Now trades as Pal.

name: ALS Automated Lab Solutions
note: One source gives 1998 and another 2011, with nothing to adjudicate between them. Jena, Germany; CellCelector cell-picking platform; acquired by Sartorius in Dec 2021. Also a scope question: automated cell-picking for lab work is not obviously a product that interfaces with the nervous system.

name: Emotion ID
note: Camera-based facial emotion detection, not EEG or any nervous-system interface, despite the description in our index implying otherwise. Year written; scope worth checking against INCLUSION_RULE.

name: Brainwave Science
note: 2005 in some sources, 2012 in others, with nothing to adjudicate. Southborough MA; iCognative brain-fingerprinting for interrogation and deception detection. Also a scope question: marketed for counterterrorism, border security and deception detection rather than as a clinical neurotechnology. VERIFIED: the company FAQ says "In 2012, Brainwave acquired patents and exclusive rights to Brain Fingerprinting" — an ASSET ACQUISITION, not a founding. The About page gives no year, saying only the company was established in a post-9/11 world. The aggregators 2012 is probably derived from that acquisition line.

name: Perfuse
note: Perfuse Inc, Los Angeles, AI for stroke care. Crunchbase lists the company but gives no founding year. Two similarly named companies exist and are NOT this one: Perfuse Therapeutics (San Francisco, 2018, ocular) and Perfusio (Greenville NC, 2016, burn imaging).

name: Neuronoff
note: I wrote 2013 from Tracxn. An independent verifier found only aggregators carry any year, spread across 2013 (Tracxn) and 2017 (CB Insights, Crunchbase, PitchBook), with no primary or press source stating one and nothing on the company site. A four-year spread from aggregators alone is not a fact.

name: G-therapeutics
verdict: duplicate of Onward Medical under a former name
note: G-Therapeutics SA (Lausanne) was renamed GTX Medical and then ONWARD Medical (Eindhoven) in 2020. Both rows describe implantable spinal cord stimulation for SCI rehabilitation. They are one company, and audit-duplicate-orgs.js CANNOT find this: it matches on normalised names, and a rename shares no letters. Found only because a verifier noted that Onward was founded under the G-Therapeutics name. Left in place; merging two rows is a decision about which /company/:id stops working.

name: Bellabee
note: Wearable neurofeedback headband. No source states a founding year; results are dominated by Bellabeat, a different company (women health tracker) with a near-identical name. Our record says Austin; product pages point to bellabee.pro. VERIFIED: no primary source gives a year, and Bellabee appears to be a rebrand or successor of the earlier ELF Emmit headband, so any date found may belong to a predecessor entity.

name: Membean
note: Vocabulary learning software for schools (durable learning). No product interfacing with, measuring or modulating the nervous system. Fails INCLUSION_RULE on its face; not searched for a year.

name: Skoolbo Pte Ltd
note: Childrens literacy and numeracy learning games. Not neurotechnology under INCLUSION_RULE; not searched for a year.

name: Mindsail
note: Wellness app with on-demand programmes. No nervous-system interface; fails INCLUSION_RULE on its face.

name: SuperBetter
note: Digital wellbeing gamification. No nervous-system interface; fails INCLUSION_RULE on its face.

name: Mentalico
note: Online psychotherapy and life-improvement platform — a service marketplace, not a product interfacing with the nervous system. Its stored website also redirected to a domain-parking host in an earlier sweep.

name: Sensory Innovation Solutions
note: Stored website is the literal string https://N/A, so there is no site to check and the name is too generic to search reliably. The bad website value is itself worth fixing.

name: Cerebian
note: I wrote 2008 from Tracxn while noting it sat oddly against the company first appearing in Ontario Brain Institute programmes in 2018. A verifier established why: the company own site has placeholder Lorem Ipsum where its story should be, the OBI release states no year, CB Insights lists none, and founder Kareem Ayyad was a school class of 2012 and 27 years old in spring 2021 — a 2008 founding would have him starting the company at about fourteen. Year cleared.

name: Atlas
note: Our row points at atlasmh.com, which an agent found is a teen wellness journaling and podcast app, now a generic mental-health content hub, marked permanently closed. No founding year is established for it. CRITICAL: a DIFFERENT San Francisco company called Atlas (atlaswearable.com) makes a behind-the-ear EEG wearable and IS neurotech. If the index means that one, this row has the wrong website, the wrong description and the wrong company.

name: Singular Hearing
note: BC Corporate Registry shows SINGULAR HEARING INC registered 1 Aug 2022, but the venture was publicly named in Dec 2019 press ahead of CES 2020 as a subsidiary of Singular Software, so the registration post-dates it. No primary source states a founding year. SCOPE: smartphone audio DSP and speech separation, no neural interface.

name: Go Go Games Studios
note: iPad matching games translating behavioural autism therapy. No sensing or stimulation of the nervous system. Year written regardless.

name: Preventicus
note: Smartphone and smartwatch PPG pulse-wave analysis for atrial fibrillation. Cardiovascular, not nervous system. Year written regardless.

name: Neuregenix
note: Preclinical contract research organisation running CNS and PNS injury models and axon-regeneration assays for drug discovery. A research service, not a device. Dissolved Jan 2025.

name: Accure Health
note: Liquid-biopsy and exosome nanosensing diagnostics for cancer and immune response. No nervous-system measurement or modulation.

name: Sleepmed
note: Measures the nervous system via polysomnography and ambulatory EEG, but operates as a diagnostic service and sleep-lab network rather than a technology developer.

name: Biotic
note: BIOTIC is the BIOmedical Translational Imaging Centre, a hospital and university research facility embedded in the IWK and QEII Health Sciences Centre and listed by the Canada Foundation for Innovation under Dalhousie University. No founding year appears on any archived page or brochure; the widely repeated 2013 could not be traced to any actual source. Should probably leave the index.

name: MyLeg
verdict: NOT A COMPANY - EU research project
note: MyLeg is EU Horizon 2020 grant agreement 780871, coordinated by Rijksuniversiteit Groningen, running 1 Jan 2018 to 28 Feb 2023 with Bologna, Twente, Roessingh, Radboud UMC and Ossur. The 2018 date is a PROJECT START and must not be recorded as a founding year. The underlying implantable myoelectric sensor work would otherwise qualify.

name: Mind Layer
note: Every archived capture (Mar 2021 to Jul 2022) is a JavaScript-only React shell whose entire body is a noscript message, and the Archive never captured the JS, so there is no About text to read. No press, register or institutional source for a biomedical-data-analysis Mind Layer could be found. The domain today serves an unrelated Korean parenting blog. Beware namesakes: MindLayer Ltd Hong Kong, mindlayer.io, Mind Layers AI.

name: NeuroCrowd
verdict: no year, and the location is wrong
note: The only substantive archived capture (Apr 2014) describes an EEG, eye-tracking and facial-recognition neuromarketing panel but states no founding year. It gives a MEXICO CITY address (WTC Mexico DF), contradicting the Houston location in our index. The site was a parking page by 2018 and the company is almost certainly defunct. Domain created 2013-08-22, which is registration not founding.

name: FK Biotecnologia
note: Autologous cancer immunotherapy and human immunodiagnostics — a drug developer with no nervous-system interface. Year written regardless.

name: Woebot
note: CBT text chatbot with no physiological sensing, only self-reported mood check-ins. It pursued FDA prescription-digital-therapeutic pathways, but that is regulatory status rather than a nervous-system interface.

name: Humachina
note: Lucidity Insights and PitchBook both give 2017; the company own site states no year. A 2018 MIT Solve application says the organisation had been operating one to two years, consistent but not a stated year. SCOPE: AI career-coaching and personalised-learning platform, no nervous-system measurement.

name: Optimal Medical Therapies
note: Home infusion therapy provider and pump supplier, part of VitalAire/Air Liquide. The only neuro-adjacent item is a discontinued RF electrode and generator for pain. Year written regardless.
